classes.name: tool_settles_exactly_once
classes.invariant: Every admitted call settles exactly once (success or error) and that settlement is in the next model request, paired with its call id; an interrupted/cancelled call reaches the model as a tool error, never as an owner-ending unknown outcome.

classes.name: call_deadline_semantics
classes.invariant: A call with deadline d settles by admission+d (simulated time) with a deadline error naming the phase; waits before execution start are reported separately and never consume execution budget silently; a call with no deadline still has a stuck-call event visible to its agent and parent.

classes.name: argument_admission
classes.invariant: Every argument defect is refused synchronously at admission, before any queue, naming the field and a valid form; opaque version tokens round-trip byte-exact through the model and partial forms are refused with the same message.

classes.name: cross_agent_head_of_line
classes.invariant: With one operation of agent X held indefinitely, every operation of an unrelated agent Y completes in the same simulated time as with X absent (independence), and no two unrelated stalls release on the same event.

classes.name: intra_step_serialisation
classes.invariant: Independent calls of one step overlap: step completion time equals the slowest call; an agent inbox is readable while its own long call runs.

classes.name: hot_path_cost
classes.invariant: The cost ledger of each operation (durable writes, fsyncs, round trips, bytes copied) is bounded by a per-operation constant and identical for empty and long histories.

classes.name: wait_without_event
classes.invariant: At simulator quiescence no task is blocked: every pending waiter is either woken or has a registered event source that the schedule can still fire.

classes.name: undriven_clock
classes.invariant: Every timer is registered with the one simulated clock; advancing simulated time past a deadline fires it exactly once, including after crash and reopen.

classes.name: wait_report_fidelity
classes.invariant: wait returns only when its need is met, its timeout fires, or with a named reason; the reported phase and progress of each child equal the oracle state at the return event.

classes.name: child_start_and_idle
classes.invariant: Every successful spawn starts its child within O(1) scheduled events; an agent with prepared context issues its request or settles with an error; a stuck child is visible to its parent.

classes.name: settlement_and_merge_latency
classes.invariant: The parent observes a child settlement at its next boundary, within O(1) scheduled events of the child committing it, with no timer involved, also mid-turn and after a reopen.

classes.name: retry_after_buckets
classes.invariant: A 429 delays only its own (endpoint, credential, model) bucket, by at least Retry-After in every form, never ends a run, never lowers configured concurrency, and releases waiters by credit rather than all at once.

classes.name: transport_faults
classes.invariant: Transient failures retry with transport backoff and never end the run; first-byte waits are bounded only by user configuration and are attributed; permanent failures settle once as errors.

classes.name: prefix_stability
classes.invariant: Request n+1 extends request n byte-for-byte except at an applied compaction; the affinity key is constant per agent; background calls reuse the agent prefix.

classes.name: length_stop
classes.invariant: A length stop never settles a turn: it continues with byte-exact reasoning; output capacity never consumes the context reservation; a length-cut background call degrades to absent.

classes.name: malformed_model_output
classes.invariant: Malformed output of an optional call degrades to absent; malformed output of a turn becomes a tool error the model sees; no malformation ends an agent.

classes.name: compaction_integrity
classes.invariant: Compaction triggers only above the configured threshold under exact accounting, is applied atomically at a boundary with no pending call/result pair split, and a failed compaction leaves the history unchanged.

classes.name: crash_at_cut
classes.invariant: For every durable cut and fault mode, reopening yields every acknowledged operation exactly once, the same agent tree (no fresh root), live children resumed, and recovered candidates visible.

classes.name: redelivery_idempotence
classes.invariant: Delivering any message k>=1 times, in any order relative to others, yields the state of one delivery; a message to a settled agent never starts a new turn unless its contract says so.

classes.name: custody_contention
classes.invariant: Self-created contention never surfaces: concurrent operations on one lineage serialise or retry on the custody event; only genuine content conflicts surface, git-style.

classes.name: fault_containment
classes.invariant: A fault injected at agent X reaches only X, as a tool error its model (or its parent, for a child failure) sees; the owner and all unrelated agents continue.

classes.name: control_propagation
classes.invariant: A control on node N applies to exactly subtree(N), including agents spawned concurrently, and acknowledges once every member quiesced; an injected-turn cancel cancels only that turn.

classes.name: declared_equals_effective
classes.invariant: Every item the effective prompt/help names resolves and is permitted in that agent view; per-role prompts render only role directives; the effective prompt is in the run record.

classes.name: path_identity
classes.invariant: For every path form, all tools resolve it to the same object or refuse with the same cause; no host physical path is visible to an agent or copied into a child.

classes.name: grant_correctness
classes.invariant: Grant decisions equal the declared policy for the agent lifetime under every custody mode; a child settling never revokes a parent read; signed payloads verify under every mounting and custody.

classes.name: fork_merge_semantics
classes.invariant: A fork is the parent snapshot at the fork cut; diff(child) equals exactly the child writes; merge is three-way with git-style conflicts; export uses the agent-selected generation.

classes.name: read_paging_contract
classes.invariant: Every (selector, offset, size) yields either a page or an explicit terminal EOF page; byte and line selectors agree; large sources page; result text is not wrapped in machine envelopes.

classes.name: omission_visibility
classes.invariant: Every omitted range is announced at its position with a pointer the same agent can read; nesting (code to shell) preserves the notice.

classes.name: execution_environment
classes.invariant: A denied syscall returns an errno to the process and never kills the tree; scratch and home are writable; result reports what executed; advertised tools exist.

classes.name: finding_publication
classes.invariant: The published set equals the fold of committed finding-file versions by any writer, at every moment while the agent runs, each counted once, surviving crash and failure.

classes.name: feedback_channel
classes.invariant: Every accepted feedback record, by any path form and write tool, reaches the channel exactly once; multi-record writes are accepted; a refused write says why.

classes.name: unbounded_growth
classes.invariant: Durable bytes and memory per step are O(delta) and per-agent cost is O(1), independent of step index, agent count and history length.

classes.name: protective_limit_hit
classes.invariant: Legitimate inputs of any size are chunked or paged and never reach a protective bound.

classes.name: span_attribution
classes.invariant: Every interval of agent wall time lies in exactly one journalled span opened at its event; usage counts every attempt; the run record holds the effective prompt.

classes.name: refusal_fidelity
classes.invariant: Every refusal class equals the true cause from the oracle and carries a usable correction.

classes.name: record_codec
classes.invariant: Every record kind emitted by a simulated agent tree decodes in every public reader with the same meaning.

classes.name: attached_client_lifecycle
classes.invariant: Attach, detach, reattach, cancel and answer never change owner state except as requested; the client view equals the owner state after each event; owner completion keeps the endpoint until an explicit stop.

classes.name: simulation_determinism
classes.invariant: Each generator world produces identical traces for a seed in-process and cross-process, and differs under the entropy-erased negative control.
